visuals: A sunny Croatian beach with clear turquoise water and a white pebble shore under a Mediterranean sky. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Get this: the coast has a Mediterranean climate with sunny skies and warm breezes.

visuals: Snowy inland mountains in Croatia with pine trees and a small mountain village in the distance. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: While inland towns have snowy winters perfect for sledding and snowball fights.

visuals: The rugged limestone cliffs of the Dinaric Alps in Croatia with a hiker trekking near a mountain goat. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Now for my favorite part: mountains! The Dinaric Alps slice through the land, creating massive cliffs and wild paths for hikers to explore.

visuals: A small brown pine marten (kuna) climbing a tree branch in a Croatian forest. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: And these mountains aren’t just for hikers… They're also home to some fascinating wildlife! The national animal is the pine marten, a tree-climbing cutie.

visuals: An old Croatian Kuna coin showing the pine marten symbol. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Its name, "kuna", was actually used as the name for Croatia's money for a long time!

visuals: A rare Eurasian lynx hiding among the bushes of a lush green Croatian forest. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: If you’re lucky, you might spot a golden eagle or a rare Eurasian lynx hiding in the national parks. They are protected and very special!

visuals: A cityscape of Zagreb, Croatia, with its iconic blue trams moving through the historic Upper Town streets. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: What’s the capital of Croatia? It’s Zagreb! The city is full of colorful trams and street art that makes the walls look like a giant comic book.

visuals: A wide view of the historic Diocletian's Palace in Split, Croatia, with its ancient stone arches and Roman architecture. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: In the city of Split, you can walk through a Roman palace that is more than 1,700 years old!

visuals: Plitvice Lakes in Croatia bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Most people speak Croatian, but in places like Istria, you’ll hear lots of Italian too. It’s a fun mix of cultures!

visuals: The historic walls of Dubrovnik in Croatia bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Around 4 million people live in Croatia. That’s about the same as Oregon! Small country, big personality!

visuals: A traditional Croatian Peka being roasted under a large iron bell-shaped lid over an open outdoor wood fire. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Yum time! Ever tried peka? It’s a fire-roasted combo of meat and veggies, sealed under a bell-shaped lid. Can you smell the smoke?

visuals: A wheel of traditional Pag cheese served on a wooden board with the rocky coast and sheep of Pag island, Croatia, in the background. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Now add Pag cheese, made from sheep’s milk on a windy island where salty herbs grow near the sea. It crumbles like magic on your tongue!

visuals: Sun-drenched vineyards on a hillside in Croatia overlooking the blue Adriatic Sea, with olive trees growing nearby. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Farmers here have been growing olives and grapes for generations. The Mediterranean sun makes them taste amazing!

visuals: A group of people in traditional attire singing Klapa harmonies on a coastal stone stage at sunset in Croatia. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Sing it with me! Klapa is Croatia’s traditional group singing! Like a human ocean wave of harmony, often heard in seaside towns during summer festivals.

visuals: Participants in medieval costumes riding horses and aiming lances during the Sinjska Alka tournament in Croatia. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: And don't miss the Sinjska Alka! every August, knights on horseback race and aim their lances with serious skill. Medieval fun in real life? Yes please!

visuals: A soccer ball on a soccer field. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: In 2018, Croatia’s soccer team surprised the world by reaching the final match! They finished as the second-best team on the entire planet.

visuals: A soccer ball on a soccer field. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: And sports fans, listen up! Luka Modrić leads on the soccer field like a boss.

visuals: Croatian tennis legend Goran Ivanišević serving the ball on a professional grass court. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: While tennis star Goran Ivanišević smashed his way to Wimbledon glory in 2001!

visuals: A spotted Dalmatian dog sitting on a rocky coastal cliff overlooking the Adriatic Sea in Croatia. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Surprise! The famous Dalmatian dog is named after Croatia's Dalmatia coast!

visuals: A traditional red silk necktie (cravat) displayed elegantly on a white dress shirt. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: The necktie, or "cravat," was invented by Croatian soldiers.
